summary.en: An AI email-to-action agent. It reads a real Gmail inbox, pulls out tasks and deadlines, and drafts a reply — but only after you approve. It never sends anything on its own.
summary.zh: 一个把邮件变成行动的 AI 助理：读取真实的 Gmail，找出任务和截止日期，经你同意后才起草回复，从不自己发出任何邮件。

en: FastAPI backend, Streamlit front end, SQLite for state, all in Docker.
Gmail OAuth with only two scopes: read, and compose drafts.
NVIDIA Nemotron models read each email; every claim is marked explicit, inference or unknown, and quotes are checked against the original.
A hard approval gate before any draft, then the draft is read back to verify it.
Built for the Nebius × NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon, with 292 tests.
zh: FastAPI 做后端，Streamlit 做界面，SQLite 存状态，整体用 Docker 打包。
Gmail 授权只开两个权限：读邮件、写草稿。
用 NVIDIA Nemotron 模型读每封邮件；每条结论都标注「明说 / 推断 / 未知」，引用的原文会逐字核对。
起草前必须经过你的确认，写完再读回来核对一遍。
为 Nebius × NVIDIA 全球 AI 黑客松而做，带 292 个测试。

short.en: AI email-to-action agent — asks before it sends.
short.zh: 把邮件变成行动的 AI 助理，发之前一定先问你。

summary.en: An automatic sign-in assistant for Universiti Malaya's Spectrum. It syncs your timetable and clicks "Present" at the right time, so you never miss an attendance check.
summary.zh: 马来亚大学 Spectrum 的自动签到助手：同步你的课表，到点自动点「Present」，再也不会漏签。

en: A small desktop app built with flet: one click to start, then it runs in the background.
Selenium drives Microsoft Edge with a saved profile, so the login is remembered.
Reads the attendance calendar with a Spectrum token and merges it into weekly time slots.
Skips sessions that belong to other OCC groups, and pauses to warn you when a session needs a password.
zh: 用 flet 做的小桌面程序：点一下开始，之后在后台运行。
Selenium 驱动 Edge，用保存好的浏览器配置记住登录。
用 Spectrum token 读取考勤日历，合并成每周固定的时段。
自动跳过不属于你所在 OCC 分组的签到；遇到需要密码的签到，会暂停并提醒你。

short.en: Syncs your timetable and signs you in on time.
short.zh: 同步课表，到点自动签到。

summary.en: A student-only reuse platform for Universiti Malaya: students who are leaving pass on furniture and appliances to students who are arriving, face to face on campus.
summary.zh: 马来亚大学学生专属的闲置互换平台：要离开的同学把家具、电器留给刚来的同学，在校园里当面交接。

en: Only verified @siswa.um.edu.my accounts can join, and every hand-over happens in person on campus.
Listings with photos, condition and pickup point; search, filters and item status.
Planned with a ten-person team over twelve weeks, starting from a survey of at least 50 students.
Tied to SDG 12.5: reuse before recycling. Still in progress.
zh: 只有验证过的 @siswa.um.edu.my 邮箱才能注册，所有交接都在校园里当面完成。
物品带照片、成色和取货点；可以搜索、筛选，能看到「可用 / 已预留 / 已出」。
十人团队、十二周排期，从至少 50 位同学的问卷调研开始。
对应联合国可持续目标 SDG 12.5：先复用，再回收。仍在进行中。

short.en: A campus marketplace, built with a team.
short.zh: 和队友一起做的校园二手市场。

tags.zh: 就是本站 · HTML CSS JS

summary.en: This site. A personal page you unroll instead of open — a brocade scroll on a dark desk, and an album for the things I've made.
summary.zh: 就是这个网站。一个要「展开」而不是「打开」的个人页——暗色书桌上的一卷锦缎手卷，和一本放作品的册页。

en: Hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript — no framework, no build step.
One feature per folder; features never import each other and only talk through events.
The paper follows your hand with inertia and snaps to the seams; the album turns with CSS 3D.
Scenes load only when you open them, so the scroll stays light.
zh: HTML、CSS、JavaScript 全部手写，没有框架，没有构建步骤。
一个功能一个文件夹，功能之间不互相引用，只靠事件说话。
纸跟着手走，带惯性，停在接缝上；册页用 CSS 3D 翻页。
场景只在你点开时才加载，手卷本身保持轻巧。

short.en: This site, as a Chinese handscroll.
short.zh: 这个网站的另一种样子：一卷手卷。
